name: dbt-spec-driven
description: Spec-driven dbt development workflow. A canonical workflow skill (spec-driven) with a route-scaled four-document spec set, mechanically enforced sub-agent delegation (PreToolUse gates on model writes and PR creation), interactive and scheduled execution modes, satellite and capability skills (spec-review, spec-debt, verify-this, ci-loop, quality-audit, pr-ergonomics, work-summary), mandatory standards in AGENTS.md including a solution ladder that prevents over-built SQL, and context-isolated sub-agents for discovery, spec authoring, test authoring, output validation, semantic view authoring, peer review, CI interpretation, and maintainability audit. Built for Cortex; portable to Cursor, VS Code/Copilot, and Codex via thin generated adapters.
